## Triage: p2 · `area:i18n` · `domain:cli` · `pm:queue` · per-string reading · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-18T12:55Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Not a duplicate.** The cloud#3002 inventory (`6247161029`) puts the platform's own runtime copy out of its scope and says it gets its own platform card. This card is that card.
- **Grade p2,** as a ruled follow-up of cloud#3002 A (`6248811507`).
- **Lane `domain:cli`,** which owns `packages/runtime`, for six of the twelve strings. The other six sit in `packages/objectql`, `metadata-protocol` and `platform-objects` (`domain:engine`). The dispatching seat either carries them under the cross-domain exception for a copy-only edit, or cuts a `domain:engine` card for them.

**The per-string reading,** on `origin/main` `1ef0ee89d4`, with the rule given for objectstack-ai/objectui#12960:

| site | sense | reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts:118`; `objectql/src/default-record-page.ts:163`; `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:1143`, `:1247`, `:22110`; `platform-objects/.../sys-metadata-activation.object.ts:151` | "made here, not from a package" | "authored in this system" |
| `runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:77`, `:164`; `share-links.ts:177`; `webhooks.ts:120`, `:131` | the system the caller is in | drop the noun ("MCP server is not enabled", "Sharing is not configured", "no webhooks service is registered") |
| `objectql/src/security-catalog-namespace.ts:212` | the catalog layer's name, plus "authored in this environment" | the parenthesis follows row 1. "the environment catalog" stays only if it is the documented name of that namespace; otherwise "this system's own catalog" |

- The other non-test hits of `this environment` (about 122) are comments. They are not this card's.
- Tests and conformance fixtures that pin these strings move with them. Pin the kind or code, not the prose, unless a consumer parses the text.

Triage's choice for the six `domain:engine` strings, "the dispatching seat either carries them under the cross-domain exception for a copy-only edit, or cuts a `domain:engine` card for them": the seat cut #24360. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is held by #23561 in flight, so the engine lane sequences them, and this claim keeps the six in `packages/runtime`.
File surface (read on `origin/main` `e4bcced0b`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/permission-set-clone.ts` (about `:118`, the clone notice): "authored in this system".
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` (about `:77` and `:164`, the 404 body): the noun is dropped.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts` (about `:177`, the 501 body): the noun is dropped.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/webhooks.ts` (about `:120` and `:131`, the redelivery refusals): the noun is dropped.
- `mcp.ts` about `:513` is a string triage did not table. The dev reads its sense, applies the rule if it reaches a user inside the running system, and otherwise leaves it and says why.
- Tests and conformance fixtures that pin these strings move with them. They pin the kind or code, not the prose, unless a consumer parses the text (triage).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json` (about `:150`): its clause quotes "MCP server is not enabled for this environment" as the 404 body, so this change makes it false, and it is fixed in the same PR. It is `domain:devx`'s file, declared on #6023 in this act.
- A `patch` changeset on `@objectstack/runtime`.
- Amended at the review, on PR #24367 (the dev's open question): the four in-lane twins of the webhooks strings, which the claim's grep missed because the phrase spans a string concatenation. They are `packages/runtime/src/domains/approvals.ts` (about `:116`–`:117`, `:126`–`:127`) and `automation-hooks.ts` (about `:126`–`:127`, `:137`–`:138`); the noun is dropped, as in `webhooks.ts`. Also `share-links.ts` about `:174`, a comment that quotes the changed 501 text verbatim, and `ai.json`'s clause, qualified so that it stays true after #24308 (an anonymous caller gets `401`, and a signed-in one gets `404`).
- ⛔ Hold-offs: #24360's six sites (`packages/objectql`, `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/platform-objects`); the roughly 122 comments that say "this environment"; `packages/spec/src/**`; `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` `:369` / `:422`, which are prose about the concept, not quotes of a server string (the dev confirms; a verbatim quote of a changed string would be fixed in this PR).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` over the surface: "Model tier — no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: copy only. Every status code, error code and response shape is unchanged; only the human-readable text moves.
Responsibility: `packages/runtime/src/domains/*`'s user-facing strings (this lane's) | none: the console's own copy moved under the same ruling (objectstack-ai/objectui#12960, PR #12962), and the server strings did not | any Setup user cloning a package-provided permission set (the notice shows under the console's "this system" hint), and any caller of the MCP, share-link and webhook-redelivery doors on a deployment where they are off
Thread-read: 6250167038
Serial constraints cleared:
- Open PRs' file lists were read in this act: none touches the four `domains/*.ts` files or `ai.json`.
- The open `pm:dispatched` claims were grepped for those paths: no hit beyond this seat's own landed #24251 (`mcp.ts`, PR #24308, merged as `889bf122e`).
- This seat's in-flight work is disjoint: #23217 slice 4 (`service-storage`, core's ledger test, the runtime conformance test, `packages/runtime`'s `package.json` and `vitest.config.ts`), and PR #24356 (`body-runner.ts`, `app-artifact-handlers.ts`, `packages/verify`).
